saliency_vs_occlusion.selection: Among the 24 catalog sources with correct balanced baseline prediction, maximize influence rank of the highest-saliency patch; first manifest source breaks ties. Curated illustration, not a held-out finding.

activation_vs_influence.selection: Among all 24 catalog sources × both convolutional layers with correct baseline predictions, maximize influence rank of the most active channel; first source/layer breaks ties. All channels are ablated independently from baseline.

shortcut_backgrounds.selection: Among catalog sources correctly classified by both models on the class-correlated background, maximize shortcut minus balanced true-class probability range across the three training colors; first source breaks ties. Gray is shown separately.
